column7: Promise: 'Know every deal. Coach every rep. Forget nothing.'; one memory in three layers. Layer 1 ('What was said') is backed by Built call capture (calendar sync, transcripts, call summaries) and documents (Content Library); its email and Slack sources are In build / Planned. In build: 'Memory layers two and three: what calls meant, and what happened next'. Flagged by the Narrative: 'Connecting the dots (the pricing example)'.
column8: INTERPRETATION (analyst view, not capability claims): Overlap: all five use one-platform or compounding language (Uniphore: intelligence that 'compounds' via knowledge and context graphs; Level AI: 'a single platform of shared intelligence' for human and AI agents; Balto: context preserved across channels and an assistant grounded in call history; Mediafly and SalesHood: one platform so teams work from the same resources). Difference: Uniphore and Level AI come closest to memory language, but at enterprise-platform or contact-center scope; Mediafly and SalesHood mean consolidated tooling, not memory. Opportunity (testable hypothesis): no inspected page promises one memory that connects calls, deals, content and coaching for a B2B sales team; test whether 'compounds' and 'shared intelligence' read to sales buyers as the same promise. NARRATIVE V1 RECONCILIATION (Oct 19, 2026): Layer 1 call capture (calendar sync, transcripts, summaries) and documents (Content Library) are Built; memory layers two and three are In build, and email and Slack sources are In build or Planned, so the connected-memory promise stays out of public copy; 'Connecting the dots (the pricing example)' is flagged.

column7: Built: transcripts from Google Meet, Microsoft Teams, Fireflies, Fathom and Granola; summaries and pre-call brief delivered to Slack; documents via the Content Library. In build: reading email for deal context (Gmail, Outlook); summaries by email and Teams; meeting bot. Planned: CRM connection (Salesforce, HubSpot) and updates; reading deal conversations in Slack; deal status from email and Slack. Flagged: 'The CRM use cases'; 'Everything about email and Slack tracking'.
column8: INTERPRETATION (analyst view, not capability claims): Overlap: Uniphore (meetings, calls, emails, CRM across Zoom/Teams/Meet), Level AI (omnichannel interactions, tickets, CRM data, screen recordings) and Balto (voice, email, chat, SMS; 60+ telephony integrations) all claim multi-source capture; Mediafly and SalesHood claim stack integration for content delivery. Difference: Level AI and Balto ingest customer-service channels and telephony, not sales email or Slack; Uniphore is the only one naming sales meeting platforms plus CRM. Opportunity (testable hypothesis): channel breadth is table stakes here as in batch 2; what each source produces for a sales team is the angle to test. NARRATIVE V1 RECONCILIATION (Oct 19, 2026): PitchSense can claim call transcripts (Google Meet, Microsoft Teams, Fireflies, Fathom, Granola), Slack delivery of summaries and briefs, and documents today; email reading is In build and CRM and Slack deal reading are Planned, so the full channel list is not a public claim.
